versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_11008, SRS_Os_11013, SRS_Os_11014 If a Task /Category 2 ISR holds an OSEK Resource and exceeds the OsTaskRe- sourceLockBudget (or OsIsrResourceLockBudget ) , the Operating System module shall call the ProtectionHook with E_OS_PROTECTION_LOCKED .

If a Task /Category 2 ISR holds an OSEK Resource and exceeds the OsTaskResourceLockBudget (or OsIsrResourceLockBud- get ) , the Operating System module shall call the ProtectionHook with E_OS_PROTECTION_LOCKED .
